caption.body:
10 product groups the Gulf buys from India.

The UAE and nearby markets take food, jewellery, textiles, electronics, engineering goods and building materials from India. The Gulf is several countries with different rules, so pick one first. Check import data and certification needs for your exact product before you quote.

Use this list as a research starting point, not proof of demand.

leadmagnet.title: Gulf Export Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: Pick a country, check the buyer, plan payment

sections.heading: Pick a country
items: Choose one Gulf country first, not all of them
Check import data for your HS code
Check certification or labelling needs for your product
Find the main port and the shipping route

sections.heading: Check the buyer
items: Search the company name with the word scam
Prefer secure payment terms for first orders

sections.heading: Before you ship
items: Confirm import rules with your customs broker
Agree Incoterms and payment terms in writing
